# DecompilerServer v1.5.0: ILSpy 11 and generic type fixes

DecompilerServer now uses ILSpy 11.2. Comparison and symbol lookup now tell a type apart from its generic twin, such as `IFoo` and `IFoo<T>`. An empty caller search now says where to look next.

### Comparison

- `compare_contexts` no longer fails on assemblies that declare a type next to its generic twin. Before, the whole call failed with "An item with the same key has already been added".
- `compare_contexts` items use the reflection name as `typeName`, for example ``N.IFoo`1`` or `N.Outer+Inner`. v1.4.0 used the full name, which drops the generic arity. You can pass `typeName` unchanged to `compare_symbols`.
- `compare_symbols` resolves one type for both contexts, so it never diffs two different types. A plain name such as `N.IFoo` means the non-generic type. ``N.IFoo`1`` selects the generic one. If a name matches more than one type, `resolution` lists the candidates and names the type it compared.
- Malformed or obfuscated metadata can repeat a type name. The repeats get `#2`, `#3` suffixes, and `typeNameCollisions` reports them.

### Lookup

- Symbols such as `N.IFoo:Method` resolve to the non-generic type, whatever the declaration order. ``N.IFoo`1:Method`` selects the generic type.
- If `find_callers` or `find_usages` finds nothing in assembly scope, the response has `hints`. When other contexts are loaded, the hint repeats the call with `scope: "workspace"`. Otherwise it suggests that you load the dependent assemblies first.

### Dependencies

- ICSharpCode.Decompiler 11.2.0.10050, up from 10.0.1.8346. ILSpy 11 writes newer C# in places, for example `default` instead of `default(T)`. Body diffs between two server versions can show these changes.
- ModelContextProtocol 1.4.2 and Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting 10.0.15.

### Updating

Restart or reconnect your MCP client after you replace the executable. If a script matches `compare_contexts` `typeName` against full names, change it to use reflection names.

Thanks to @konstant16-Z for #54, #55 and #56.

All 253 Release tests pass locally. A freshly launched server also passed an MCP smoke test.

Requires the .NET 10 runtime. Downloads are available for Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, and Linux x64 and ARM64.
